messages:
Aisha: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands  live thread for short strategy Qs on mission/positioning/competitors. Keep Qs 1-2 lines.
Omar: For new logos, lead with one line  performance or ops?
Aisha: One line: "Predictable, economical inference for production apps." Then choose a proof point (latency for product teams, TCO for platform).
Lina: Should marketing mention open models up front?
Marco: Put platform benefits first; mention open-model support as a secondary bullet.
Kei: Competitors undercut hosted price. Tactical advice?
Aisha: Don't race to lowest list price. Emphasize real TCO after batching/caching and faster time-to-live.
Marco: Engineering highlight: automatic routing + prefix/KV caching + optimized kernels = lower p95 under load.
Lina: We'll make two one-liners (dev vs infra) and a 1-slide cheat sheet for Sales this week.
ops-bot: docs.redwood.ai/sales/cheatsheet (shared link) :link:
Omar: Thanks  will await assets.
Aisha: Closing thread in 24h unless more Qs. Keep it brief!
